title: Pointing & claiming

steps.say: Every note is filled in for you. Now you'll use the notes to rule numbers out.
In this box, the 3 notes sit in one column. Tap both cells.
steps.nudge: Find the two cells in the box with a small 3.

steps.say: Turn Pencil on to edit notes.
steps.nudge: Pencil is the key at the bottom right.

steps.say: This column's 3 has to be one of those two. So rub out the 3 up here.
steps.nudge: Select the outlined cell, then press 3.

steps.say: When a number's notes in a box sit on one line, clear it from the rest of that line. That's pointing.
Now the reverse: in this row, the 7 notes sit inside one box. Tap both cells.
steps.nudge: Find the two cells in the row with a small 7.

steps.say: So the box's 7 must be in this row. Rub out the box's other 7.
steps.nudge: Select the outlined cell, then press 7.

steps.say: When a row or column keeps a number inside one box, clear it from the rest of that box. That's claiming.
Your turn: the 4 notes in this box share a column. Clear that column's other 4.
steps.nudge: Follow the bright column up, out of the box. Which cell still has a 4?

steps.say: Turn Pencil off. Your clean-up left some cells with one note.
steps.nudge: Tap Pencil to go back to writing answers.

steps.say: This cell lost its 3. Place the number that's left.
steps.nudge: Read the one note left in the outlined cell.
Read the one note left in the outlined cell.

steps.say: Finish the board! Start with cells that have one note.
steps.nudge: Look for a cell with a single note, or a number with one spot.

outro: Solved! When a number's notes line up inside a box or a line, clear it from the rest.
